description: This file implements an update runner for a project, managing git operations, package installations, build processes, and health checks, with detailed step tracking and error handling.

methods.name: normalizeDir
methods.description: Normalizes a directory path, resolving it to an absolute path or returning null if invalid.

methods.name: resolveNodeModulesBinPackageRoot
methods.description: Resolves the package root from a node_modules/.bin path.

methods.name: buildStartDirs
methods.description: Builds an array of starting directories based on options and process cwd.

methods.name: readBranchName
methods.description: Reads the current git branch name for a given root directory.

methods.name: listGitTags
methods.description: Lists git tags matching a pattern, sorted by version.

methods.name: resolveChannelTag
methods.description: Resolves the appropriate git tag for a given release channel (beta or stable).

methods.name: resolveGitRoot
methods.description: Finds the git root directory from a list of candidates.

methods.name: findPackageRoot
methods.description: Finds the package root directory by locating package.json with a specific name.

methods.name: detectPackageManager
methods.description: Detects the package manager used in a given root directory.

methods.name: managerPreferenceOrder
methods.description: Returns an ordered list of package managers based on preference.

methods.name: managerVersionArgs
methods.description: Returns the command-line arguments to get the version of a package manager.

methods.name: isManagerAvailable
methods.description: Checks if a package manager is available by running its version command.

methods.name: isCommandAvailable
methods.description: Checks if a command is available by executing it.

methods.name: ensurePnpmAvailable
methods.description: Ensures that pnpm is available, enabling corepack if necessary.

methods.name: resolveAvailableManager
methods.description: Resolves the best available package manager, considering fallbacks.

methods.name: runStep
methods.description: Executes a command step, tracking timing and output, and invoking progress callbacks.

methods.name: managerScriptArgs
methods.description: Generates command-line arguments for running scripts with different package managers.

methods.name: managerInstallArgs
methods.description: Returns install command arguments for different package managers, with optional fallback.

methods.name: normalizeTag
methods.description: Normalizes a package tag input, defaulting to 'latest'.

methods.name: mergeCommandEnvironments
methods.description: Merges two environment objects, with override taking precedence.

methods.name: runGatewayUpdate
methods.description: Main function to perform the update process, handling git operations, package installs, builds, health checks, and error reporting.
